name: Data.endLevel_le_principalLevel
summary: An element of endLevel reduces into nodeLevel, which lies in the kernel of reduction modulo 𝔟; that is membership in the principal level.

steps.claim: For k ∈ endLevel(ϑ₁, z, b′): its reduction modulo gridModulus(ϑ₁) lies in nodeLevel, which is contained in the kernel of the reduction to the untwisted modulus (`ite_le_sup`, the trivial level ⊥ ⊔ …); the reduction modulo 𝔟 = gridModulus(1) factors through it (`Modulus.factor_reductionK₀`), so k reduces to 1 modulo π̄^{b₁}, i.e. lies in the principal level (`Modulus.mem_principalLevel_iff`, `Data.gridModulus_one_ideal`).
steps.lean:
fun _ ⟨_, k, a⟩ ↦ a ▸ (Modulus.mem_principalLevel_iff gridModulus_one_ideal _).2
  ((Units.ext (Modulus.factor_reductionK₀ ..)).symm.trans
  (((ite_le_sup ..).trans_eq (bot_sup_eq _) : nodeLevel .. ≤ _) k))
